name: home-assistant
description: Home automation platform with host networking recommended for IoT discovery

fields.name: CONFIG_LOCATION
fields.label: R1: Config Folder
fields.help: Host folder for Home Assistant configuration, integrations, automations, and application state.

fields.name: TZ
fields.label: R2: Timezone
fields.help: Timezone used by Home Assistant, such as Asia/Dubai or Europe/Amsterdam.

fields.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_NETWORK_MODE
fields.label: O1: Network
fields.help:
Host Mode is recommended and is the official Home Assistant configuration. It makes discovery of IoT devices and integrations using mDNS, SSDP, UPnP, HomeKit, and similar local-network protocols much easier.
You may instead create a bridge or select an existing Docker network, but automatic device discovery may be limited.

fields.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_PORT
fields.label: O2: Bridge Web UI Port
fields.help:
Host port used only with bridge or an existing Docker network.
In Host Mode, port mapping is not used and Home Assistant is available directly on NAS port 8123.

fields.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_PRIVILEGED
fields.label: A1: Privileged Mode
fields.help:
The official Home Assistant Container configuration enables privileged mode, which gives Home Assistant broad access to host devices for hardware integrations.
Disable it only if you want a more restricted setup and understand that required USB devices must then be mapped explicitly below.

fields.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_DEVICE_MAPPING
fields.label: A2: USB Device Mapping (If Privileged Is Disabled)
fields.help:
Normally unnecessary while Privileged Mode is enabled.
If you disable Privileged Mode, explicitly map the Zigbee, Z-Wave, or other USB adapter Home Assistant needs. Example: /dev/ttyUSB0:/dev/ttyUSB0. A stable /dev/serial/by-id/... host path is preferable when available. Leave blank when no explicit mapping is needed.

fields.name: DBUS_MOUNT
fields.label: A3: D-Bus Mount for Bluetooth
fields.help:
Only needed for Home Assistant's local Bluetooth integration when the NAS has a Bluetooth adapter and its operating system provides a working Bluetooth service such as BlueZ.
Enter /run/dbus:/run/dbus:ro to enable access to the host D-Bus socket. Leave blank when the NAS has no supported Bluetooth hardware, when the host does not provide D-Bus/BlueZ, or when using network Bluetooth proxies such as ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy.

fields.name: DISABLE_JEMALLOC
fields.label: O3: Disable jemalloc
fields.help: Leave at Use Default normally. Select Disable only when logs report jemalloc: Unsupported system page size, which can occur on some ARM64 systems.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O4: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_IMAGE
fields.label: A4: Image
fields.help: Official stable Home Assistant Container image. This installation type provides Home Assistant Core without Supervisor or apps.

fields.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_PORT_MAPPING
fields.label: A5: Bridge Port Mapping
fields.help: Automatically generated port mapping for bridge or an existing Docker network. It is removed in Host Mode.

fields.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker sets the container name from the project name.

ui.overview: Home Assistant connects local devices and services so you can monitor and automate your home from one interface.
what_happens: One Home Assistant Container will be created using the official stable image
Home Assistant configuration and application state will be stored in a bind-mounted host folder
Host networking is selected by default so IoT devices and discovery protocols work more reliably
When Host Mode is selected, Home Assistant opens directly on NAS port 8123 and no Docker port mapping is generated
Bridge and existing Docker networks remain available, but some automatic device discovery may not work
The optional advanced D-Bus mount enables local Bluetooth only when the NAS has a supported adapter and a working host Bluetooth service
An optional USB device mapping can expose a Zigbee, Z-Wave, or similar adapter
This is Home Assistant Container and does not include Supervisor or Home Assistant apps
ui.data_location: The configuration folder can be relative to this app's config folder or an absolute host path. Back it up before major Home Assistant upgrades.
